issues.on_page: 579.08 printed at B30 (line 3 Investments); B31 (line 4 County Treasurer's Balance) is '-'
issues.issue: The computed note puts the 579.08 under the wrong component. On the skewed scan the B-code next to 579.08 is B30, which is Investments, not the County Treasurer's Balance. The subtotal of 177,172.86 is correct either way.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: In Lieu of Tax 49,520.00 (B40); column 1 shows 0.78 (B12) and the budget column shows '-'
issues.issue: This matches the page (B40), but an in-lieu-of-tax receipt of 49,520 for an agricultural society, against 0.78 the year before, looks like the preparer may have entered it on the wrong line. It is recorded as printed; a person should confirm the line.
